description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homaga, Homaga D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad Map No. 520001 (24/0520)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, parcel numbers, cadastral map references, owner information, and land extent measurements. The content focuses entirely on land ownership registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
